title: A holder at 24.5% is open to offers: just below the 25% flag line

input.facts: Immunoassay instruments with proprietary reagents; consumables and service are 66% of sales. The share price fell 27% after a product transition delayed the launch of a new analyzer, now shipping. Leverage 2.1x. The largest holder is a family foundation with 24.5%, a plain financial stake with no board seat or special rights. The foundation has said publicly that it is open to offers for its shares. No other holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: a holder under the 25% line, open to offers, triggers no flag and no kill criterion
